_comment: Shared signal definitions for BOTH engines (src/scoring.js and app.py). Regexes must stay JS/Python-compatible: no lookbehind, no named groups, no \p{}. Matched case-insensitively.

dimensions.label: Headline bait
dimensions.guidance: The headline withholds the point to make you click. Skim for the one paragraph that actually answers it before deciding it matters.

dimensions.label: Sensational tone
dimensions.guidance: The wording is built to provoke emotion. Restate the facts to yourself in neutral words and see if they still seem as dramatic.

dimensions.label: Headline vs. body
dimensions.guidance: The article doesn't clearly back up its own headline. Compare the headline's claim with the first few paragraphs before sharing it.

dimensions.label: Weak sourcing
dimensions.guidance: Few named sources or evidence. Look for who is quoted by name, and check whether two independent outlets report the same claim.

dimensions.label: Low transparency
dimensions.guidance: Missing byline, date or publisher. Find out who wrote this and when before trusting or sharing it.

dimensions.label: Manipulation & scam tactics
dimensions.guidance: This page uses pressure or scam tactics. Don't buy, click through, or hand over personal data. Verify the claim through an official source.
